notes: SR78 Container Store Decor (containerstore.com). ACCESS: curl_cffi Chrome-family impersonation, ~4-6s pacing, profile rotated per request; all fetches 200, no blocks encountered this session. DISCOVERY: 'Clearance' is a dedicated, permanent top-level nav department (id 62895, /s/clearance/1), styled in red in the mega-nav CSS to distinguish it, with its own department-shaped subnav of 9 genuine per-department Clearance children plus one cross-cut discount-tier filter. SALE VS CLEARANCE CHECK: the page's own breadcrumb reads simply "Clearance" and internal analytics pageName/pageType is literally "Category:Clearance" (categoryId 62895) -- this is the site's own permanent taxonomy label, not a temporary promo. The og:title/meta description do blend the words "Sale & Clearance Event" (marketing copy), but every one of the 9 department-level children is independently labelled "Clearance: <Dept>" throughout the ENTIRE site's mega-menu (Clearance: Kitchen, Clearance: Closet, Clearance: Storage, Clearance: Home Decor & Pet, etc, visible on every department's own subnav, not just this hub) -- the same permanent structural pattern the site uses for its ordinary Shop-by-Department nav, which is strong first-party evidence this is evergreen outlet/clearance merchandising rather than a dated campaign. Not flagged ambiguous. CHILDREN: opened and verified all 10 nodes under categoryId 62895's nav array. 9 are genuine per-department Clearance listings (Elfa, Closet, Storage, Kitchen, Office and Gift Packaging, Laundry and Bath, Travel, Home Decor and Pet, Garage and Shelving), each its own URL/categoryId/totalCount. The 10th, "Clearance Up to 80 Off" (categoryId 92888, qty 109, /s/clearance/clearance-70-off/12), is a percent-off-tier cross-cut of the same underlying Clearance pool spanning multiple departments, not a distinct department -- DROPPED as a re-cut, same precedent as dropping Framed-Art/Alarm-Clock style cross-cuts in the prior Home-Decor pass (a hand-computed discount-depth slice is not a genuine additional branch). Sum of the 9 kept department children (54+59+129+158+374+80+69+53+7=983) exceeds the parent total (907); this is expected department-bucket overlap (a product can be tagged into more than one department's Clearance bucket), consistent with the same overlap pattern seen in New Arrivals below -- not an error, not deduplicated. No local-language variants applicable (USA/English site).
